# Nathan Perrier Portfolio

Nathan Perrier's portfolio is an interactive Three.js room with an accessible standard portfolio and terminal alternative.

## Pages

- [Interactive 3D portfolio](https://nathanperrier.dev/): The primary experience, with projects, a terminal, and an arcade in a virtual room.
- [Standard portfolio](https://nathanperrier.dev/portfolio/): A conventional, accessible summary of experience, skills, education, and projects.
- [Terminal](https://nathanperrier.dev/terminal/): A command-line styled portfolio experience.
